_meta.title: Enemy tag -> covenant counter/suffer matrix (卫戍协议·规程)
_meta.season: 卫戍协议·规程 序列Ⅰ
_meta.confidencePolicy: This is the WEAKEST-evidenced part of the research. Only the rows tagged confidence=medium are grounded in game text or a named community claim. Everything else is my inference from covenant mechanics and MUST be validated by play. Do not ship these weights as authoritative.
groundedSources: https://prts.wiki/w/卫戍协议·规程/PRTS盟约记录 (covenant effect text — the机制 column is quoted/derived from here)
https://prts.wiki/w/卫戍协议·规程/PRTS盟约记录 §战术特训敌人 (the 9 tags and their official descriptions)
https://ngabbs.com/read.php?tid=47953257 (莱塔尼亚 '一键删除频次隐匿致命')
https://a.9game.cn/mrfz/11575447.html (low-reliability counter hints: 阿戈尔 vs 海怪, element healing)
_meta.structuralNote: Countering is mostly EMERGENT from covenant text, not from a published table: 奥术's 3-man effect makes 隐匿 fail in range; 炎 accelerates enemy element-damage recovery; 叙拉古 stacks 异常状态; 坚守 shares damage. So derive counters from effects, and treat this file as a starting prior.

matrix.officialDesc: 拥有优秀的造成伤害和承受伤害能力

counters.why: ATK +(35+0.75×层数)%, HP +(10+0.3×层数)%, and 击倒 stacks — wins attrition stat-checks
ATK ramps on every deployment up to +(50+1×层数)%; 6-man adds 65% true damage
ignores 30% DEF and RES at 3-man — directly answers tanky units
devours a neighbour for 5000 physical + inherits ATK/block, huge single-target body

matrix.notes: The generic 'big stats' tag; almost any committed comp handles it. Low priority for the recommender.

counters.why: 3-man extends the buff to ALL ranged operators — the only covenant that explicitly widens to ranged
summons 一个小节/一个乐部 provide extra bodies + 攻速+20; community calls it a blanket answer
雪山巨人 does ranged splash in 巨人形态

suffers.why: single-operator buffs give no air coverage breadth
melee devour engine contributes nothing to air

matrix.notes: The clearest structural counter is 'bring enough ranged/anti-air', which is a lineup property, not a covenant property. Model it as a requirement on the operator set, not a covenant weight.

matrix.officialDesc: 需要一定攻击次数击破

counters.why: high summon count + 攻速 = many hits; NGA explicitly: '一键删除频次隐匿致命'
6-man: 30% chance per attack to apply debuffs, plus per-second true damage once 2+ debuffs — many hits, many procs
skill-end SP refund → higher skill uptime → more hits
50-layer: ALL operators +50 attack speed

suffers.why: one huge devour hit is wasted on a hit-count shield

matrix.notes: Punishes single-big-hit comps; rewards attack-speed and summon density. 突袭's +50 ASPD is a clean, cheap answer.

matrix.officialDesc: 拥有造成元素损伤的能力

counters.why: heals 生命值 AND 元素损伤 ((8+0.06×层数)% ATK/s) in range — the only explicit element-damage recovery
6-man raises enemy element-damage RECOVERY +(40+0.3×层数)% — note this is a double-edged ally-side effect; also adds random element damage
40% damage sharing smooths burst element damage

matrix.notes: 聚合 is the designed answer. Community also cites 哈洛德 (谢拉格/维多利亚) as an element healer and 桑椹 (炎) as an alternative, but those are operator-level, not covenant-level.

counters.why: sustained AoE healing counteracts DoT
3-man: 40% of damage on non-坚守 operators is redistributed and partly converted; plus 反伤 + 脆弱
6-man converts (15+0.05×层数)% of damage taken into 10s life-loss that stops when the source dies

matrix.notes: Sustain check. 聚合+坚守 is the natural defensive pairing.

counters.why: 3-man: enemies in 奥术 operators' range lose 隐匿 — the ONLY explicit reveal in the covenant set

matrix.notes: STRONGEST single mapping in this file: 隐匿 -> 奥术, stated in the game text. Treat as a hard requirement.

counters.why: ignores 30% RES at 3-man, partially offsets reflection
equipment-driven damage scaling (not pure arts burst)

suffers.why: arts-heavy; reflection punishes high arts damage

matrix.notes: A DEBUFF tag for the popular 莱塔尼亚/奥术 line — this is where 'enemy tag counters the meta comp' actually bites. Weight it as a penalty on arts comps.

matrix.officialDesc: 在特定条件下造成高额伤害

counters.why: damage sharing + 脆弱 reflection + heal-adjacent
shield (15+0.08×层数)% at 3-man plus healing
6-man: first 3 阿戈尔 revive once — absorbs a lethal burst
(18+0.4×层数)% chance of instant redeploy on ground operators
NGA lists 致命 among the tags 莱塔尼亚 deletes (summon bodies soak)

matrix.notes: Burst-survival check. Several partial answers; no single hard counter.

counters.why: per-second true damage + debuff lockdown keeps re-killing
stacking DoT + 20% bounce keeps pressure through the revive window
summon swarm sustains damage without cooldown gaps

suffers.why: assassination/reposition bursts are wasted on a revive

commonComps._note: Names/cores are from community discussion + covenant rosters in covenants_operators_regulation.json. Treat operator picks as examples, not doctrine.
